stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('programs/task-5e744369.py'); p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Recolor the isolated single cell matching the color of the dominant non-background shape to 0.
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
      for j,v in enumerate(row):
        if v==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
        stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          x,y=stack.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
          for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=x+dx,y+dy
            if 0<=a<len(grid) and 0<=b<len(row) and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==v: seen.add((a,b)); stack.append((a,b))
        comps.append((v,cells))
    # In examples, singleton marker color equal to main shape indicates recolor to 0.
    for v,cells in comps:
      if len(cells)==1 and sum(1 for w,cs in comps if w==v and len(cs)>1)>0: out[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]=0
    return out
')"
